prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to my initials for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through Pasadena, Texas, on my way to the store. I was turning left at an intersection with a green light, or at least I thought it was green when I started the turn.

Q: What happened as you began the turn?

A: I pulled into the left turn lane and waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. When it looked clear, I started turning. Then a vehicle coming straight through hit the front passenger side of my car. I didn't see it until it was basically on me.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle's signal or speed before the impact?

A: No, not really. It happened fast. I heard the horn and then the impact.

Q: Where were you injured?

A: My right knee took the brunt of it. It hit the dashboard. I've been having a lot of swelling and I can't bend it all the way. I went to the emergency room that afternoon.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment for the knee?

A: Yes, I have an appointment with an orthopedic doctor next week. They mentioned they might want to look at an MRI.

Q: Did you have any pain or problems with that knee before the collision?

A: No. I had no issues with it before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, because I can't work the way I usually do right now.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
